name: DataForSEO
one_liner: REST API suite for SEO and search data, including keywords, SERPs, backlinks, and on-page analysis.
auth_notes: Credential mechanism is not stated on the fetched pages.
access_notes: Fetched pages do not say how credentials are issued. A July 1, 2026 page says all endpoints moved to pay-as-you-go with monthly commitments cancelled.

buildability.rationale: Documented public REST API with a sandbox and pay-as-you-go pricing. Credential issuance and auth scheme are not stated on the fetched pages, and the npm MCP page returned 403.

identity.quote: This is the starting point on your journey towards building powerful SEO software, data analysis pipelines, and robust no-code automations.

access.quote: moving all endpoints to a pay-as-you-go model by cancelling monthly commitments.

sandbox.quote: You can test DataForSEO Labs API for free using DataForSEO Sandbox.

api_surface.quote: DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
Each of DataForSEO APIs has a certain rate limit, which you can find in the HTTP header of every endpoint.

needs_human_reason: Credential mechanism, endpoint breadth, and MCP status are not on the fetched pages; the npm package page returned 403.
